name: Service Stop
summary: Adversaries may stop or disable services on a system to render those services unavailable to legitimate users. Stopping critical services can inhibit or stop response to an incident or aid in the adversary's overall objectives to cause damage to the environment. Services may not allow for modification of their data stores while running. Adversaries may stop services in order to conduct Data Destruction.

analytics.name: Analytic 2140
analytics.guidance: Real-time monitoring identifies systemctl stop or kill commands targeting Industrial Control System (ICS) service processes on Linux assets, from a User Identifier (UID) that is not the ICS service owner or an authorized system administrator.
